tests.name: Effective description
tests.reasoning: The description uses imperative phrasing ('Use this skill when...'), focuses on user intent (auditing CloudTrail coverage, asking whether an action would be recorded, pasting trail output), and explicitly lists many trigger contexts including negative scope ('Do not use for...'). While dense, it stays within a reasonable paragraph length and clearly delineates when to use vs not use the skill.
tests.evidence: Use this skill when a user asks to audit or review CloudTrail coverage or configuration, says their auditors need to know exactly what is being logged, asks whether CloudTrail would record an action such as an object delete or a function invocation... Do not use for CloudTrail cost, bill, duplicate trail waste or data event charge questions...

tests.name: Verbosity and conciseness
tests.reasoning: The body is dense and domain-specific throughout, focusing on CloudTrail-specific facts (full ARN rule, selector semantics, coverage states) rather than explaining general concepts the agent already knows. It avoids filler explanations of basic AWS or audit concepts.
tests.evidence: Organization trails by full ARN, always. A failed name call is a mistake to retry, never a permission boundary.

tests.name: Detailed reference materials must not be in body
tests.reasoning: Detailed reference material (API call tables, full error tables, full report template, permissions lists) is kept in references/ files and only summarized or pointed to in the body. The Fixed Check Matrix and Coverage Model sections give condensed summaries but detailed severities/full tables are explicitly offloaded to check-matrix.md.
tests.evidence: Full rules, selector semantics and worked examples: [coverage-model.md](references/coverage-model.md), loaded at Step 6.

tests.name: Reference files must be linked
tests.reasoning: Every file in references/ (check-matrix.md, cloudtrail-api-reference.md, coverage-model.md, permissions.md, report-template.md) has at least one markdown link in the body.
tests.evidence: [cloudtrail-api-reference.md](references/cloudtrail-api-reference.md): calls, fields, hard denials, full ARN rule, errors, pagination, quirks. Step 1.

tests.name: Reference links must specify when to load
tests.reasoning: Each reference link specifies a loading condition such as a specific step number or trigger event (AccessDenied, Step 1, Step 6, Step 8, Step 9).
tests.evidence: loaded on `AccessDenied`. ... loaded at Step 6. ... loaded at Step 1.

tests.name: Reference path format
tests.reasoning: All reference links use relative paths of the form references/<filename>.md with no absolute paths or traversal.

tests.name: Prescription vs description
tests.reasoning: Fragile, correctness-critical operations (full ARN calls, denied-call handling, rating roll-up) are given exact prescriptive rules, while sections like 'Why This Skill Exists' and general scope explanation are descriptive, matching prescriptiveness to fragility.
tests.evidence: A failed name call is a mistake to retry, never a permission boundary. `CoveredByOrgTrail-Unverified` exists only after the ARN call failed.

tests.name: Defaults, not menus
tests.reasoning: The skill doesn't present multiple competing tools/approaches as equal choices; it specifies exact API calls and a single fixed procedure for each step without alternative library/tool options.
tests.evidence: The skill doesn't present multiple tool/approach options; API calls like ListTrails, DescribeTrails etc. are prescribed directly.

tests.name: Favor procedures over declarations
tests.reasoning: The skill teaches a generalizable procedure (resolve scope, inventory trails, map selectors to resources, compute coverage states, render report) that applies to any account/resource set, not a one-off instance.
tests.evidence: Step 1. Resolve scope. ... Step 6. Map selectors to resources. ... Step 7. Per resource table.

tests.name: Gotchas section
tests.reasoning: The skill has an explicit 'Known Quirks' section documenting non-obvious environment-specific facts (Event history limits, multipart upload event names, shadow trails, GetBucketLocation null for us-east-1).
tests.evidence: S3 multipart uploads emit `CreateMultipartUpload`, `UploadPart`, `CompleteMultipartUpload`, not `PutObject`; bulk deletes emit `DeleteObjects`.

tests.name: Templates and outputs missing
tests.reasoning: The skill provides a detailed output contract and a dedicated report-template.md reference file for the structured report it must produce.
tests.evidence: The final message to the user is the full report defined in [report-template.md](references/report-template.md)

tests.name: Templates and outputs must not be in body
tests.reasoning: The body does not inline a large template; it only summarizes section names and delegates the full template to report-template.md in references/.
tests.evidence: Render from [report-template.md](references/report-template.md) at Step 9: one Trail Inventory row per unique trail and store...
